**ECZ-ID Drone Insurance Readiness**（VS Code 扩展 `ecocitizenz.eczid-drone-insurance`）**是一个**整理**无人机（**UAS）运行证据**以**供核保审阅**的**编辑器插件****——**逐字自述为**「**Organise drone / UAS operational evidence for insurance review.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**编辑器插件市场：保险关键词下到底有什么**」**。

**可核实信息（均 VS Code 市场接口与其自带说明实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 把「**不上传**」写成**三条承诺之一****——**⭐ 本次实测**其说明逐字含**「**Free, local-first. No source upload. No sign-in to run a check.**」**；**⭐ 并**逐字说明**它怎么工作**：**「**Surfaces Drone / UAS operations and related evidence — locally, by filename and path.**」与**「**Builds a local, claim-free evidence summary you can review and share.**」**（**⭐ 本条**照原文引用，**不替它**解释 **`claim-free`** 的确切含义**）**；**⭐ 另有**「**Routes to Resolver lookup, implementation guidance and supported setup.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**在**保险资料**这种**敏感输入**上**，「**本地优先、**不上传、**不登录**」**三条**本身就是**一种**产品主张**——**⭐ 而**它**把**这三条**写在**最前面**，**不是**藏在**隐私条款里**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它要整理的证据被逐项写出，**而**这正是「**新兴风险核保**」**缺的东西****——**⭐ 本次实测**其说明逐字含**「**you are gathering flight-log / Remote-ID / authorisation evidence**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是本条最有价值的部分**：**⭐ 即**「**无人机保险**」**听起来抽象**，**而**它**被**落到**三类**可核对的文件**上**——**飞行日志、**远程识别（**Remote-ID）与**授权文件**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**任何**新兴风险的**核保**，**第一步**都是**把**「**看什么材料**」**写清楚**——**⭐ 本条**就是**一个**具体例子**。**⭐⭐ ③ 它写明面向谁、**何时有用****——**⭐ 本次实测**其说明逐字列出**「**Drone / UAS operators**」**、**「**Brokers and risk engineers**」**、**「**Compliance reviewers**」**与**「**Insurer-facing stakeholders**」**，**并**逐字给出**「**Relevant when**」**的**若干情形**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**它**把**经纪人**与**风险工程师**放在**使用者名单里**——**⭐ 而**这**恰好**是**保险价值链上**最需要**证据整理**的两类角色**。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 可核查性止于市场页面****——**⭐ 本次实测**其元数据里**没有**源码仓库地址**（**⭐ 而**本轮**同批**另一家**发布方**的插件**则给出 **GitHub 地址**）**；**⭐ 其**许可链接**逐字指向 **`https://ecocitizenz.com`**（**发布方官网**）**；**⭐ 它**带 **Changelog 与 **Details 两个资产**（**⭐ 即**说明与**变更记录**齐备**）**。**⭐ 本词条**据此**如实指出**：**⭐ 对**这类**插件**，**读者**能核对的**只有**市场页面的**元数据**与**作者自述**——**⭐ 故**引用时**应**注明**「**据其市场页与**自带说明**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[underwriting-workbench]]、**[[underwriter-os]]、**[[paco-uw]]、**[[application-fill-provenance]] 与**[[quotelens-provenance]] 覆盖**核保工作台与**材料来路**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把**新兴风险（**无人机）的**运行证据**整理成**核保材料**的**编辑器插件**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**，**也**未核实**其**与**任何**核保平台**的关系****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **处理**敏感输入**时**把**「**本地优先、**不上传、**不登录**」**写在**最前面**；**② **把**抽象风险**落到**具体材料清单**（**本条为三类文件**）**；**③ **写明**面向哪几类角色**与**何时有用**；**④ **没有仓库时**要**如实说明**，**不要**让读者**以为**能**自查**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装、**没有运行**该扩展**（**未做任何证据整理、**未生成任何摘要**）**，**故**不主张**其**功能可用**、**不主张**其**「**不上传**」这一承诺**在**实际运行中**成立**、**也**不主张**其**输出**可用于**任何**核保决定**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**市场接口返回的**元数据**与**其自带的**说明与**变更记录**（**未读**其**扩展包内的**代码**）**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与**发布方**及**任何**保险人的**关系**（**⭐ 本条**只记录**其**自述与**许可链接**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**它**如何处理**本地文件**（**⭐ 只知其**自述为**不**上传**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**对**无人机法规**（**如**远程识别要求**）**的覆盖是否**准确**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其**同族**另一款（**`eczid-humanoid-insurance`，**人形机器人**保险就绪）**与本条的**具体差异**（**⭐ 本词条**按**同发布方同形**规则**只收本条**，**未做**代码级比较**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该插件**不是**保险产品**，**也**不是**核保意见**。

e.body_en:
This Visual Studio Code extension **is an editor plugin that organises drone and uncrewed aircraft operational evidence for insurance review**, described verbatim as doing exactly that. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the editor plugin marketplace, and of what is actually there under insurance keywords.**

**Verified information, all measured from the marketplace interface and the text the extension ships**: **first, it makes not uploading anything one of three promises.** The description states verbatim that it is free, local-first, that there is no source upload and no sign-in to run a check, and it explains how it works, surfacing drone and uncrewed aircraft operations and related evidence locally by filename and path, and building a local summary that the user can review and share, before routing to a lookup, implementation guidance and supported setup. **In the context of sensitive insurance input, local-first operation with no upload and no sign-in is itself a product claim, and putting those three statements first rather than burying them in a privacy note is the part worth copying.** **Second, the evidence it gathers is listed concretely, which is exactly what newly emerging risk underwriting lacks.** The description names flight logs, remote identification and authorisation evidence. **Drone insurance sounds abstract until it is reduced to three checkable document classes, and for this project the first step in underwriting any emerging risk is to write down which materials are examined.** **Third, it names who it is for and when it is relevant**, listing drone operators, brokers and risk engineers, compliance reviewers and insurer-facing stakeholders, and the situations in which it applies. **Putting brokers and risk engineers on the user list is notable, because those are the two roles in the insurance value chain that most need evidence organised.** **Fourth, verifiability stops at the marketplace page**: its metadata records no source repository, its licence link points only at the vendor website, and it ships changelog and description assets but nothing that can be inspected independently. **For a plugin of this kind a reader can check only the marketplace metadata and the author own account, so any citation should say so.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover underwriting workbenches, an underwriting operating system, application and quote provenance, **while this entry supplies an editor plugin that turns emerging-risk operational evidence into underwriting material. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them and does not verify any relationship to any underwriting platform.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: state local-first, no-upload and no-sign-in behaviour up front when handling sensitive input; reduce an abstract risk to a concrete list of materials, as this does with three document classes; say which roles it is for and when it applies; and when there is no repository, say so plainly rather than letting readers assume they can check it themselves.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the extension was neither installed nor run**, so no evidence was organised and no summary produced, **and no claim is made that it works, that the no-upload promise holds in operation, or that its output is usable for any underwriting decision**. **Second, only the marketplace metadata and the description and changelog it ships were read, not the code inside the extension package.** **Third, its relationship to the publisher and to any insurer was not verified**, only what it states and where its licence link points being recorded. **Fourth, how it handles local files was not verified**, beyond its own statement that nothing is uploaded. **Fifth, whether its coverage of drone regulation, such as remote identification requirements, is accurate was not verified. Sixth, the exact difference between it and its sibling for humanoid robot insurance readiness was not verified**, this entry collecting only one of the two under the same-publisher same-pattern rule without any code-level comparison. **Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the plugin is neither an insurance product nor an underwriting opinion.**
